en: Color postcard-style image showing a large waterfront building complex with a central, flat-roofed, light-colored block and an ornate, historic-looking facade on the right. Several floors of windows and balconies face a calm harbor. Two white passenger boats are moored along the quay in front of the buildings. Cars are visible along the street by the water. At the bottom border of the image, handwritten text reads "WAXHOLM II".
